help.en: A user journey the solution serves, rated by the value it brings and how feasible it is.
Who asks, such as "customer" or "agent".
A large pre-trained model used through prompts, with its price and speed.
The instructions given to a model, with the tokens it uses, so its cost and latency can be calculated.
Tokens sent per call: instructions, context and question.
Tokens of a typical answer.
How often it runs per request, on average: 3 for three times, 0.2 for one request in five.
Input and output tokens times the price of its model.
Time to first token plus the time to write the output, in milliseconds.
Cost per call times calls per request.
Latency per call times calls per request.
The version and the cost per request, shown on the diagram.

constraints.message: = 'Prompt "' + Name + '" runs on no model: connect it to one with "Uses model".'

help.en: A program that uses a model to plan and take actions with tools, within the autonomy it is given.
The most steps it may take for one request.
How many tools it can use.
How many guardrails protect it.
The cost of its prompts and retrieval per request.
The time its prompts and retrieval take per request, in milliseconds.

constraints.message: = 'Agent "' + Name + '" can use tools, but no guardrail protects it.'
= 'Agent "' + Name + '" acts alone, and no person reviews it.'

constraints.formula: CostLimit == null || CostPerRequest == null || CostPerRequest <= CostLimit
constraints.message: = 'Agent "' + Name + '" costs ' + CostPerRequest + ' per request, more than its limit of ' + CostLimit + '.'

help.en: A check on what goes into or comes out of a model, or a policy it must follow.
What happens when the check fails.
A measured test of a flow, agent, prompt, model or retriever on a test set. Passed compares the score with the threshold.

attributes.formula: Score == null || Threshold == null ? null : Score >= Threshold

help.en: Yes when the score reached the threshold.

attributes.formula: (Metric ?? 'Score') + ' ' + (Score == null ? '-' : text(Score)) + ', at least ' + (Threshold == null ? '-' : text(Threshold))

help.en: The score and the threshold, shown on the diagram.

constraints.message: = 'Evaluation "' + Name + '" tests nothing: connect it with "Evaluates".'

help.en: The flow that handles a request: which prompts it calls, what it retrieves and which agents it hands work to. Cost and latency per request are added up from them.
The average cost of one request: its prompts, its agents and its retrieval.
The average time to answer one request in milliseconds, when the steps run one after the other.
Cost per request times requests per day.
The daily cost times 30.

constraints.message: = 'Flow "' + Name + '" handles no use case: connect it to one with "Handles".'
= 'Flow "' + Name + '" needs an input guardrail and an output guardrail.'

help.en: A function a flow or agent can call, such as looking up an order. Tools that change data or act outside need an approval.
The system the tool calls.
Acts outside: sends messages, pays money or does anything else beyond the own data.
A person confirms each call before it runs.

constraints.message: = 'Tool "' + Name + '" changes data or acts outside, but needs no approval.'
= 'No flow or agent uses tool "' + Name + '".'

help.en: The steps that find the right passages for a request: sources, chunking, embedding, the index, the retriever and the re-ranker. Place them inside it.
The latency of the steps inside, in milliseconds.
The cost of one search through the steps inside.
The name and the latency, shown as the heading on the diagram.
Content the solution searches, such as help articles, policies or past tickets.
How the content is split into passages before it is embedded.
The strategy and the size, shown on the diagram.

constraints.formula: ChunkSize == null || Overlap == null || Overlap < ChunkSize
constraints.message: = 'The overlap of "' + Name + '" is not smaller than its chunk size.'

help.en: The model that turns passages and questions into vectors, so similar meanings lie close together.
The length of each vector.
Where the vectors of all passages are stored and searched.

constraints.formula: Dimensions == null || IFERROR(incoming('Feeds')[0].Dimensions, null) == null || Dimensions == incoming('Feeds')[0].Dimensions
constraints.message: = 'Vector index "' + Name + '" has ' + Dimensions + ' dimensions, but the embedding model that feeds it makes ' + incoming('Feeds')[0].Dimensions + '.'

help.en: Finds the passages that match a question, by meaning, by keywords or both.
How many passages it returns.
Puts the passages found in a better order and keeps the best few.
How many passages it keeps.
Shown on the diagram.

constraints.formula: TopN == null || IFERROR(incoming('Feeds')[0].TopK, null) == null || TopN <= incoming('Feeds')[0].TopK
constraints.message: = 'Re-ranker "' + Name + '" keeps more passages than the retriever returns.'

help.en: A person who checks what a flow, agent or tool does, before or after it happens.
The role that reviews.
A use case, agent or application relies on a model.
An evaluation tests a model or a prompt.
The flow serves the use case.
The flow or agent sends the prompt to its model.
The flow hands part of the work to the agent.
The flow or agent may call the tool.
The flow or agent finds context through the retrieval pipeline.
One retrieval step passes its result to the next.
The guardrail checks what goes into or comes out of the flow, agent, prompt or tool.
A person checks what the flow, agent or tool does.
The monthly cost of all flows.
Use cases, the flow that handles them, prompts and foundation models, a retrieval pipeline, agents and tools, guardrails, evaluations and human review.

parts.fill: = SideEffects == 'Read only' ? '#d3f9d8' : SideEffects == 'Changes data' ? '#ffec99' : SideEffects == 'Acts outside' ? '#ffc9c9' : '#e9ecef'
